description: We are a group of highschool students who wants to spread stories and fun facts with the world in a fun and accessible way. To learn is to have fun, to enjoy, and to strive for more. Creating an interactive story is the way to go
summary:
An interactive comic with the goal to educate young learners about the forgotten and lost technology in Mars made by NASA. Teaching them about the technology along with qualities such as problem solving, teamwork, and compassion ; caring for others. 
It is essentially a comic with built in games in it to challenge the reader and make it a more memorable and interesting comic for the readers.
Technology is important but human qualities such as compassion, teamwork, empathy and caring for others is important. The earlier a person is exposed to these qualities the better. 
Here we have a robot named Robby and his friend named Snooby Dooby who accompanies him in his journey to find the remnants of humans in a red planet which they will find out is named Mars. There Robby will encounter Insight Lander and Ingenuity Helicopter where they will learn its different parts and the environment in Mars.
details:
It is an interactive comic meaning it is a comic with additional features which the readers could interact with such as mini games or puzzles. This creates a more memorable experience for the reader allowing the information to stick longer.
We wanted it to not only be educational theoretically but also in terms of humans qualities. Qualities such as teamwork, compassion and empathy is extremely crucial for us to survive in the real world and we would like to expose young learners to these qualities.
The interactive comic makes use of Javascript, HTML, and CSS. As our coding abilities are not high enough to create the games, we made use of super intelligence such as ClaudeAI to help us create the code.
Normal comics are common so we wanted to be different by including puzzles and games. Young learners especially could have a hard time focusing which was why we decided on an interactive comic with a cartoon artstyle and soft colors so it's easy on the eye. Additionally, we included as stated before lessons about the qualities as we believe it is an important factor in our lives.

AI was used to create sound affects, game assets, and a picture which was included into the comic, a text is written at the parts where AI is used.
dataRefs: The Fact and Fiction of Martian Dust Storms
